hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.rs) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then L=${XDG_RUNTIME_DIR:-/tmp}; exec 8>"$L/luna-rebuild.pending"; flock -n 8 || exit 0; exec 9>"$L/heavy-jobs.lock"; flock 9; flock -u 8; fi; out=$(cargo build --workspace --all-targets 2>&1 && cargo build --release --workspace --all-targets 2>&1 && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: rebuild (debug+release, all targets) + clippy --all-features (queued: one heavy job at a time on this machine)
hooks.rewakeMessage: rebuild-discipline hook: the full rebuild (`cargo build --workspace --all-targets` then `--release`) and/or `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` FAILED after your .rs edit. Fix before continuing:
